known.via: English Wikipedia "Tursan" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A South West France appellation. The main grapes allowed are Gros Manseng and Baroque for white and Tannat and Cabernet Franc for red.
